component.summary: Type Thai and English with your voice
พิมพ์ไทยและอังกฤษด้วยเสียง

description.p: Turn Thai and English speech into editable text on your Linux desktop. Choose a local speech model, record with your microphone or open an audio file, and review the result before pasting it.
Models are downloaded separately. Once the required models are installed, speech processing runs locally. Text and audio history are off by default.

ul.li: Edit, copy, retry, and translate Thai text into English
Select your microphone and test its input level
Download, verify, switch, and remove speech models
Inspect processing devices and compatibility information
